physics-killer-07.material: Kana tichiona kubva paPasi, chinhambwe chokusvika kuhunyanzvi hwenyeredzi imwe chiri gore-chiedza $6$. Spaceship inobva paPasi ichienda kunyeredzi iyi nokumhanya kwakaenzana $0.6c$ ichisvika kunyeredzi. Ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wenguva yokubhururuka yakayerwa nemuongorori wepaPasi nenguva yakayerwa newachi iri mukati mespaceship zvichitevedzana? (Zvakaenzana, kumhanya kwechiedza $c$ ndi $1$ gore-chiedza/gore.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Kana tichiona kubva paPasi, chinhambwe chokusvika kuhunyanzvi hwenyeredzi imwe chiri gore-chiedza $6$. Spaceship inobva paPasi ichienda kunyeredzi iyi nokumhanya kwakaenzana $0.6c$ ichisvika kunyeredzi. Ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wenguva yokubhururuka yakayerwa nemuongorori wepaPasi nenguva yakayerwa newachi iri mukati mespaceship zvichitevedzana? (Zvakaenzana, kumhanya kwechiedza $c$ ndi $1$ gore-chiedza/gore.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.explain: Muongorori wepaPasi: $\Delta t=\dfrac{6\text{ gore-chiedza}}{0.6c}=10$ gore. $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.6^2}=1/0.8=1.25$. Wachi yespaceship inoyera kubva nokusvika pachinzvimbo chimwe chete, saka iri proper time uye ndi $\Delta t_0=\Delta t/\gamma=10/1.25=8$ gore. Kuwedzera kunopa $12.5$ gore (nhema ③), kuparadzanisa ne $\gamma^2$ kunopa $6.4$ gore (nhema ①), kutsiviana kwemanhamba ndiyo nhema ④. (Kubva pakuona kwespaceship, chinhambwe chinopfupisa kusvika $6/1.25=4.8$ gore-chiedza uye chinoenderana ne $4.8/0.6=8$ gore.)

physics-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
